feature_title: Dashboard Table Cell Copy & Drilldown Actions

rationale.edition: OSS. Every one of the nine changed paths lives under web/src/** or tests/ui-testing/** (the open-source tree). None are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/, and no enterprise keyword (SSO/SAML/RBAC/cipher/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appears in any changed path or symbol — so this is an open-source change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. The change is user-facing: TableRenderer.vue restructures the table cell copy + drilldown hover actions, and MetricsExplorer.vue changes stream refresh. The trigger comment and feature hint are empty and no tests-added label was passed, so there is no explicit opt-out marker.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The cell copy button (previously native enableCellCopy) and the drilldown search icon were both moved into a floating cell-hover-actions toolbar with new data-test hooks (dashboard-table-cell-copy-* and dashboard-table-cell-drilldown-*), changing how users copy and drill into cells. Metrics Explorer also now forces a stream reload on open/refresh.
rationale.area: Dashboards. The bulk of the UI change lives in web/src/components/dashboards/panels/TableRenderer.vue, and the changed E2E specs are under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/.
rationale.group: Dashboards-Tables. The changed specs dashboard-table-copy-cell.spec.js and dashboard-table-column-formatting.spec.js are already registered in that shard's run_files in the cloud matrix (actual_folder Dashboards).
rationale.existing_tests: Three Playwright E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/ are changed in the diff — dashboard-legends-copy.spec.js, dashboard-table-column-formatting.spec.js, and dashboard-table-copy-cell.spec.js — and they target the exact cell-copy behavior being refactored (updated to the new data-test hooks). TableRenderer.spec.ts is a Vitest unit test, not E2E coverage, so it does not factor into E2E coverage.
